parameters.content: WF2 — UUID prospect classification from submitted tender context. Called only by WF1; no public test webhook or external search tool. Persists a partial prospect record in the deployed UUID schema, then starts matching. Rebind Postgres and Z.ai credentials. Public source research needs an approved provider and evidence validation.

parameters.query: SELECT id, title, source, raw_payload, extracted, deadline FROM leads WHERE id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1;

options.systemMessage: Return one JSON prospect card from the provided tender only. Never invent revenue, projects, partners, or source URLs. Set partial=true because public facts were not verified.

parameters.text: ={{ 'Classify only the supplied tender and organisation fields. No web research is available. Set partial=true, leave externally unverifiable facts null or empty, and sources empty. Tender context: ' + JSON.stringify($json) }}

parameters.query:
WITH payload AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p)
INSERT INTO prospects (lead_id, org_name, sector, revenue_estimate, projects, partners, needs, evidence, partial, warnings)
SELECT (p->>'lead_id')::uuid,
       NULLIF(COALESCE(p->'raw'->>'organisation', p->'raw'->>'organization'),'')::text,
       p->>'sector',
       CASE WHEN (p->>'revenue_estimate') ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN (p->>'revenue_estimate')::numeric ELSE NULL END,
       COALESCE(p->'past_projects','[]'::jsonb), COALESCE(p->'partners','[]'::jsonb),
       COALESCE(p->'domain_needs','[]'::jsonb), COALESCE(p->'raw'->'sources','[]'::jsonb),
       COALESCE((p->>'partial')::boolean,false),
       CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(p->'raw'->'sources','[]'::jsonb))=0 THEN '["No public sources verified"]'::jsonb ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
FROM payload RETURNING id, lead_id;
UPDATE leads SET status = 'researched', updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, status;

UPDATE leads SET status = 'failed', updated_at = now()
WHERE id = NULLIF($1::jsonb->>'lead_id','')::uuid RETURNING id, status;
